questions.prompt: Where does the application source product knowledge: embedded documents loaded at deployment time, or queries to an existing external knowledge base API?
questions.why: This determines the data architecture: embedded requires document parsing + vector storage in the app layer; external KB requires API client, auth, and network calls. Affects build scope, deployment complexity, and knowledge freshness strategy.

questions.prompt: How should analysts authenticate: local username/password accounts managed by the application, or single sign-on (SSO) via company identity provider?
questions.why: Determines authentication layer design: local requires user/password schema + session management; SSO requires OIDC/SAML integration. Impacts security posture, deployment model, and operational burden.

questions.prompt: How long should conversation records be retained before automatic deletion: indefinitely, 1 year, 90 days, or another interval?
questions.why: Shapes data-tier retention policies and cleanup job requirements. Affects database schema design, query patterns for archival, and compliance reporting.

questions.prompt: How is an approved reply delivered to the customer: via automated integration (email, ticketing system API, etc.), or manually by the analyst copying it into their existing tool?
questions.why: Determines integration surface: manual requires no downstream APIs; automated requires outbound connectors, error handling, and delivery status tracking. Affects backend design and deployment risk.
